name: Serve The Servants

evidence.note: Band site: Long Island Nirvana tribute aiming to copy the Nirvana live show.
Oct 3 'Unplugged' show at The Warehouse, Amityville, with Love Hate Love and Unglued.
Plays grunge tribute festivals alongside Alice in Chains and Pearl Jam tributes.

dancing.notes: A Nirvana tribute is a rock concert where fans watch, sing and sometimes mosh. This weekend's show is billed as Unplugged (acoustic), so expect a listening crowd.

description: A Long Island Nirvana tribute trio, playing since 2023, that recreates Nirvana's early-90s live show, from the guitar and vocals to the bass lines and hard-hitting drums.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Band site lists Oct 3 as 'Unplugged at Katie's / Katies of Smithtown', but AllEvents and Ira's List put the Unplugged show at The Warehouse, Amityville. Owner may want to confirm the venue.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current links confirmed from the band's own site; added TikTok and the band's public contact email. No separate contact/booking page (the /contact URL is a 404; contact is a section of the home page). Upcoming LI show not in our data: 89 North, Patchogue, Dec 12, 2026 (with No Doubt tribute Hella Doubt); other listed dates are in Brooklyn and Stroudsburg, PA. The Oct 3 'Unplugged' venue question (Katie's of Smithtown vs. The Warehouse, Amityville) is now past and no longer on the band's list, so I could not settle it. No logo file on the site (the logo only appears on a stage banner in photo 2). Skipped a photo with a heavy scratched-film effect and a background texture.
